DUSU Elections: ABVP Wins 3 Posts, Independent Takes VP Seat

In the Delhi University Students' Union (DUSU) elections for 2026, the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) secured three positions. An independent candidate, Deepanshu Shokeen, won the Vice-President's seat. The National Students' Union of India (NSUI) did not win any posts and faced criticism after a rebel candidate from their organization won the Vice-President's position as an independent.
